**Synopsis:**
Wall Street closed higher on Aug 25, led by a tech rebound ahead of Nvidia's earnings report. Falling Treasury yields and oil prices provided relief. Key near-term catalysts include Nvidia's results (Wed), PCE inflation data (Wed), and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech (Fri). Consumer confidence dropped to a 7-month low. Markets are pricing one 25bps rate hike by year-end. AMD surged on an upgrade; Dick's Sporting Goods cratered on a guidance cut; Target fell on a brand controversy.
